[b]What it do:
[/b]
This changes the scarecrow and all 8 of the rarecrows in the game to be cats on different pedestals/cat climbing tower thingies. Its pretty darn cute. Who wouldn't want ferocious guard kitties to keep the crows at bay?
[b]
[/b]

[b]Download:
[/b]
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/191/?tab=2&navtag=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexusmods.com%2Fstardewvalley%2Fajax%2Fmodfiles%2F%3Fid%3D191&pUp=1]Download Here[/url] on the Nexus (just click the file name or "download manually")


[b]Installation Instructions:
[/b]
[list]
[*]Download the mod
[*]Extract the archive
[*]Go to Stardew Valley/Content/TileSheets
[*]Replace the Craftables.xnb file with the one from the download
[/list]
**You can easily create a backup of your original Craftables.xnb file by renaming it to something silly. I do Craftables.xnbOLD for myself.
